verdict.summary: The change is coherent and complete as scoped. Blank-node-bearing SELECT results are encoded as one RDF structure with distinct row nodes, preserving bag multiplicity, unbound rows, variable identity, and cross-row blank-node sharing before independent RDFC-1.0 canonicalization. Graph results correctly use set semantics, unsupported RDF-star/generalized-RDF inputs fail closed, and the explicit HNDQ limit converts pathological canonicalization into triage. The focused tests exercise relabeling, non-isomorphic rewiring, wrong values, sharing mismatches, duplicate rows, all-unbound rows, ground-table parity, invalid inputs, and the bench harness's distinct counted bnode-triage route. Documentation honestly states that end-to-end harness wiring remains deferred, so it does not overclaim coverage.
